about_the_game:
Operation Purge is a single-player, sci-fi survival game that blends atmospheric exploration with story-driven progression and light horror elements. You play as an astronaut who crash-lands on Saturn’s moon, Titan, after responding to a distress signal from a missing crew. Stranded and alone, you must uncover what happened — and survive long enough to escape.

Key Features:

  • 🌌 Story-Driven Exploration:
    Investigate the source of a mysterious distress signal while navigating abandoned research stations and damaged facilities on Titan.

  • 🧍 Main Character:

    Step into the suit of a lone astronaut sent on a rescue mission, now fighting to survive and continue the journey through a shattered outpost.

  • 🔧 Tool Searching & Repairs:
    Scavenge for tools and components in the wreckage and use them to repair damaged systems and unlock new areas. Progress often depends on successfully fixing doors, terminals, power units, and more.

  • 🫁 Survival Mechanics:
    Keep an eye on your oxygen and water levels. Supplies are limited, and you’ll need to explore carefully to find what you need to stay alive.

  • 🩸 Subtle Horror & Atmosphere:

    Bloodstains, strange noises, and unsettling environments hint at something gone terribly wrong,

Operation Purge offers a slow-paced, atmospheric sci-fi experience focused on exploration, survival, and environmental storytelling. The gameplay revolves around searching for tools, solving repair-based tasks, and managing limited resources like oxygen and water. The game emphasizes a sense of isolation, mystery, and progression through logic and observation — ideal for players who enjoy immersive, narrative-driven adventures with light survival elements and a subtle tension throughout.

content_descriptors.notes: Visible blood, bloodstains, and disturbing, horror-themed environments and sounds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 SUPER / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-14700K / AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Operation Purge is a story-driven sci-fi survival game set on Titan, Saturn’s mysterious moon. Explore the terrain, manage limited resources, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the surface. Will you survive long enough to find the truth?
